title: Learn Backend with Go
tagline: Idiomatic Go APIs from first handler to production services
description: A three-level curriculum for building backend services with Go — from HTTP and SQL through authenticated APIs to systems you can test, cache, observe, and ship. Focus on the standard library plus a small, production-oriented toolkit.
prerequisites: Comfort using a terminal, Git, and a code editor
Willingness to install Go and a local PostgreSQL instance

levels.title: HTTP, SQL & First APIs
levels.goal: Stand up a small HTTP API that reads and writes real data

topics.title: Go for services
items: Packages, structs, interfaces, and error returns
goroutines awareness without premature concurrency
go.mod, go fmt, and project layout

topics.title: How the web talks
items: HTTP methods, status codes, and headers
JSON encoding/decoding
REST principles: resources, URLs, and idempotency

topics.title: SQL & relational design
items: Tables, primary keys, and foreign keys
SELECT, JOIN, WHERE, and GROUP BY
Indexes you actually need on day one

topics.title: Handlers and routing
items: net/http ServeMux or a light router (chi/Echo)
Context, timeouts, and middleware
Structured logging (slog or zerolog)

topics.title: Talking to PostgreSQL
items: database/sql or pgx with parameterized queries
sqlc for type-safe queries (optional but recommended)
Migrations with golang-migrate or goose

topics.title: Git & API clients
items: Branch, commit, and PR habits for backend teams
Exploring endpoints with curl, Postman, or Bruno
Docker Compose for a local Postgres

projects: CRUD API for members or products with Postgres
README or OpenAPI that documents every endpoint
Docker Compose so a teammate can run the API locally

levels.title: Authenticated, Tested Services
levels.goal: Ship APIs with auth, validation, migrations, and tests you trust

topics.title: Authentication
items: Password hashing and sessions vs. JWT
OAuth/OIDC at a working level
Refresh tokens, expiry, and logout

topics.title: Authorization
items: Role checks in middleware
Resource ownership in handlers
Least privilege for service credentials

topics.title: Repositories and migrations
items: Repository pattern over raw SQL/sqlc
Forward-only migrations and rollbacks
Transactions for multi-step writes

topics.title: Validation & errors
items: Request validation (go-playground/validator or manual)
Consistent error types and HTTP mapping
Idempotent creates for retries

topics.title: Go tests
items: table-driven unit tests
httptest and integration tests with a test DB
testify assertions and mocks where they help

topics.title: API contracts
items: OpenAPI as documentation and contract
Detecting breaking response changes
Seed data that matches production shapes

topics.title: Redis and query cost
items: When to cache vs. when to fix the query
Cache keys, TTLs, and invalidation
EXPLAIN and slow-query awareness

projects: REST API with JWT/session auth, roles, and tests
Migration-backed schema for a real feature
Rate-limited public endpoint with documented error codes

levels.title: Production-Grade Backend Systems
levels.goal: Design services that stay correct under load, retries, and money-moving traffic

topics.title: Service boundaries
items: Monolith vs. services — when each is enough
Context cancellation across handlers and workers
Outbox pattern for reliable side effects

topics.title: Workers and messaging
items: Background workers with queues (NATS, SQS, or Redis)
Retries, dead-letter queues, and poison messages
Idempotency keys for at-least-once delivery

topics.title: API security
items: Injection, mass assignment, and secrets in env
Rate limiting, CORS, and webhook signature verification
PII handling and audit logs

topics.title: Ledger-style consistency
items: Immutable ledger rows vs. mutable balances
Idempotent payment and transfer endpoints
Reconciliation when callbacks are late or duplicated

topics.title: Logs, metrics, traces
items: slog with request IDs
Prometheus metrics or OpenTelemetry
pprof for CPU/memory when needed

topics.title: Containers and config
items: Multi-stage Docker builds and scratch/distroless images
12-factor config and graceful shutdown
Health checks and migrations in CI

projects: SACCO member and savings API with role-based access
Containerized Go service with CI tests and OpenAPI
